programs.title: Love in the Forecast
programs.desc: An aspiring meteorologist befriends a neighbor who teaches her the importance of trusting nature and each other.

programs.title: Hearts Around the Table: Jenna's First Love
programs.desc: Jenna plans a charity event for billionaire Tom Redlands. But working with Tom's right hand Andrew is proving difficult, especially since Jenna and Andrew have a romantic history.

programs.title: Hearts Around the Table: Shari's Second Act
programs.desc: Shari just moved back to D.C. after a breakup and hopes to start painting again. Inspiration hits when she meets Evan, a repairman who winds up actually being a gallery owner.

programs.title: To Philly with Love
programs.desc: A teacher and an archivist decode Revolutionary War-era love letters, taking them on a thrilling journey through Philadelphia where they uncover history and discover a love story of their own. Stars Rebecca Dalton, Stephen Huszar.

programs.title: At Home in Mitford
programs.desc: Cynthia, an author, leaves Boston to spend some time in her late uncle's small town in hopes of alleviating writer's block. She soon meets a man, and as the pair work together to help a boy, they find solace, comfort, and even romance.

programs.title: Write Place, Write Time
programs.desc: Paige just wants to be a writer, but her mom wants her to follow in her footsteps in a big conglomerate company. After discovering that Atlas Publishing will be sold, she opts to write under a pseudonym.
